metadata.target_role: Project Executive - PMO Center of Excellence

red_flags.detail: PMP certification is required by the JD; resume lists it as In Progress with exam targeted Dec 2026.
PMP line has stray capital 'On-site', awkward fragment, and undefined acronym 'TIA'; inconsistent spacing in degree field slash.

'Owned master project schedules in every role since 2014' contradicted by Vanyshr founder role; 'Program Executive' headline not supported by titles held; 150+ implementations in 4 years invites managed-vs-owned scrutiny.
Template uniformity and JD-echo phrasing in ringldr/Cornerstones bullets and skills; undefined acronym TIA. No metric cliches or hidden text observed; metadata not verifiable.
BS Psychology/Sociology and MSW do not match required Business/PM/Engineering/IS or related field.
Mix of year-only and Month YYYY formats; concurrent ringldr role overlaps all later roles.
Mixed: specific engagements (State of Alabama module, Excelsior Springs Hospital, $245K savings) alongside generic JD-mirroring bullets.

parsing_risks: [DATE RISK] mixed year-only and Month YYYY date formats
[CHRONOLOGY RISK] low: concurrent ringldr role listed above later-starting Cornerstones role; labeled concurrent
Skills section is a single long pipe-delimited line (parses but poor readability)
PDF layout and metadata not verifiable from text input

must_haves: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification (required; in progress only)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (held: Psychology/Sociology; MSW)
Proven success leading PMO governance, audit, compliance, or Center of Excellence initiatives (partial: no PMO/CoE role, one audit engagement)
Experience developing and governing scheduling standards across multiple projects, programs, or portfolios (partial: asserted in summary, thinly evidenced)
Partnering with executives to improve forecasting accuracy and project visibility (partial: generic, little outcome evidence)
preferred: Experience implementing or optimizing Professional Services Automation and resource management processes
Experience evaluating and implementing project management technologies and reporting solutions (partial)
Advanced experience building executive dashboards and project performance reporting frameworks (partial: tool keywords only)

Correct 'every role since 2014' and the 'Program Executive' headline to match titles actually held; ensure all claims survive reference and HRIS checks.

Degree field cannot be changed; offset with experience-based framing and any genuine PM/business coursework, and address with the recruiter.
